title: Geologic Map of Mars (USGS Scientific Investigations Map 3292)
authors: Tanaka, K. L., Skinner, J. A., Dohm, J. M., Irwin, R. P., Kolb, E. J., Fortezzo, C. M., Platz, T., Michael, G. G., & Hare, T. M.

chronostratigraphic_units.name: Late Amazonian Highland Unit
chronostratigraphic_units.description: Smooth to etched deposits, young volcanic and aeolian mantles in Tharsis and Elysium.

chronostratigraphic_units.name: Middle Amazonian Lowland Unit
chronostratigraphic_units.description: Vast northern plains resurfacing deposits, periglacial patterned ground in Utopia and Arcadia.

chronostratigraphic_units.name: Early Amazonian Volcanic Unit
chronostratigraphic_units.description: Lava flows forming the shields and plains of Olympus Mons, Ascraeus, Pavonis, and Arsia Mons.

chronostratigraphic_units.name: Late Hesperian Lowland Unit
chronostratigraphic_units.description: Vastitas Borealis Formation, catastrophic outflow flood sediment sheets.

chronostratigraphic_units.name: Early Hesperian Volcanic Unit
chronostratigraphic_units.description: Wrinkle-ridged basaltic plateau plains in Hesperia Planum and Syrtis Major.

chronostratigraphic_units.name: Late Noachian Highland Unit
chronostratigraphic_units.description: Intercrater plains dissected by dense valley networks, extensive phyllosilicate clays.

chronostratigraphic_units.name: Middle Noachian Highland Unit
chronostratigraphic_units.description: Heavily cratered ancient crust, complex impact structures, Noachis Terra.

chronostratigraphic_units.name: Early Noachian Highland Unit
chronostratigraphic_units.description: Most ancient surviving Martian crust, Hellas and Argyre impact basin rims.
